note: parse_die() (bfd/dwarf1.c) walks `xptr` (initialized from `aDiePtr`, a pointer into the raw .debug_info section bytes read directly from an attacker-supplied object file) through DWARF1 DIE attributes. For FORM_STRING, it calls strlen((char *) xptr) -- the pointer cast is elided by the compiler since bfd_byte is unsigned char, so the call operates directly on xptr -- to measure the DIE's name attribute. An unterminated name value causes the scan to read past the section buffer.

traces.message: bfd_byte *xptr = this_die; : aliases aDiePtr, a pointer into the raw untrusted .debug_info section bytes
xptr += strlen((char *) xptr) + 1; : reads past the section buffer when the name attribute isn't NUL-terminated within it
